dct_description_sm: 3 bar scales on map, given in "Milliaria Lotharingica Magna," "Communia," and "Parua."
From De Jode's Speculum orbis terrarum, Antwerp, first published in 1578, reissued by Cornelis in 1593.
This copy has pencil inscriptions on bottom of sheet, e.g., in lower left: 95.
